meta.source: 智联招聘 (Zhaopin) recruitment export 2016–2025.7, supplied by the user
meta.method: Each ad's job title and description were read by the fixed rules in backend/ageparse.py; the city was mapped to a province and the job title to an occupation by keyword rules (backend/realdata.py); counts and medians were then summed per province and occupation, with no ad text kept.
